installRole: An owner or administrator installs updates.
auto.heading: Automatic updates
auto.level.label: Automatic level
auto.level.hint: Off by default. Existing enrollments always stay on the release they started.
auto.interval.label: Check every (hours)
auto.interval.hint: At least 1 hour; 24 by default. Failed checks wait longer each time (up to 7 days).
auto.acknowledge: I authorize automatic review approval and publication of new versions from this source for new learners, as me. It is refused, and the version is left as a draft in review, when the check finds a blocking problem, a host requirement that is not identical, a failing runtime check, a newer required Core or an SDK outside the supported range.
auto.registry: Also approve a packaged recovery registry whose digest differs from the registry approved for the live release. Without this, only an unchanged registry is approved automatically; a changed one waits for an owner or administrator.
